# Publishing — 0109 What happens when you click Sign Up?

## Title

WHAT SIGN UP REALLY DOES

## Caption (Instagram)

```
A Sign Up button is the last step, not the security. The form validates, the server checks the request, the password is stored as a hash, and a session keeps you signed in.
```

Length: 172 characters.

## YouTube Shorts

**Title:** What happens when you click Sign Up?

**Description:**

```
A Sign Up button is the last step, not the security. The form validates, the server checks the request, the password is stored as a hash, and a session keeps you signed in.

Sources:
- Client-side form validation checks required fields and formats before data is submitted to the server. (Client-side form validation (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Forms/Form_validation checked 2026-10-31
- Client-side validation can be bypassed, so the server has to validate again. (Client-side form validation (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Forms/Form_validation checked 2026-10-31
- HTTPS is HTTP carried over an encrypted connection, so the request travels sealed. (HTTPS (MDN Glossary)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Glossary/HTTPS checked 2026-10-31
- The server checks the request again before anything is stored: allowed, not an existing account, and within the rules. (Client-side form validation (MDN)) https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Learn_web_development/Extensions/Forms/Form_validation checked 2026-10-31
- Passwords should be stored as a slow salted hash, never in plain text. (Password Storage Cheat Sheet (OWASP)) https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Password_Storage_Cheat_Sheet.html checked 2026-10-31
- A session token identifies the user on later requests so the password is not sent again. (Session Management Cheat Sheet (OWASP)) https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Session_Management_Cheat_Sheet.html checked 2026-10-31
- The button itself provides no security; the checks, the permissions and the password handling do. (Password Storage Cheat Sheet (OWASP)) https://cheatsheetseries.owasp.org/cheatsheets/Password_Storage_Cheat_Sheet.html checked 2026-10-31
```
